post.summary: Set a phone up to match the policy
post.description: Applies every rule of the policy profile that adb can set (such as radios and data off, Data Saver, the default SMS app, screen settings, and removing the listed apps, which deletes their data), then re-reads and verifies. Idempotent: a phone that already complies gets no commands. Answers 409 without a profile. Requires Content-Type: application/json (an empty `{}` body is fine) or `X-Spareline: 1`.

get.summary: The bytes of an MMS attachment, with its content type
Device events and texts as Server-Sent Events
get.description:
Server-Sent Events for device events (`event: device`) and ingested texts (`event: message`). `types=device,message` picks the streams (default `device`).

Each event's `id` is the cursor of the streams you asked for: `<deviceEventId>` with `types=device`, `<seq>` with `types=message`, and `<deviceEventId>:<seq>` with both. With that value as `after` (or Last-Event-ID, which EventSource sends when it reconnects), the stream replays everything after it, oldest first, then streams new events. A bare number with both types is a device-event id; texts then start with the next new one. Without a cursor, `latest=N` replays the newest N device events, and otherwise only new events are sent. A `: keep-alive` comment is sent every 15 s.

schema.description: A cursor in the event id format; Last-Event-ID wins
Without a cursor: replay the newest N device events

get.description: One entry per phone with a scrcpy session or viewers. A session stops 30 s after its last viewer leaves.

ws.description: Text frames are JSON: hello {width, height} at every session start, then status and stats. Binary frames are scrcpy 3.3.3 video packets, unchanged. The client may send scrcpy control messages of types 0-4 (key, text, touch, scroll, back-or-screen-on), at most 4 KiB each; anything else is dropped and counted. A browser's Origin must match the Host. Close codes: 4001 phone offline, 4002 session failed, 4003 the session ended (signed out, password changed, or removed), 1001 server shutting down.
